doc.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Electric bass, acoustic bass at eleven, and Free Flight
summary: He began on electric bass, moved to acoustic at eleven, and played in a fusion band Free Flight and in Joshua Redman's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Did you start out on acoustic?

I started on electric bass. And I started to play the acoustic bass when I was eleven when I started going to junior high school. So ever since then I still pretty much do a juggling act. You know the gigs that I’ve had in the last few years never called for electric bass so I just never had a chance to play it in public. So a lot of people forgot that I still play electric bass because I used to play with a band, everyone always kids me about this, actually I only did a few gigs with them, but I used to play in this fusion band called Free Flight. A flute player named Jimmy Walker and Mike Garson the piano player, and Alex Acuna played drums. And that group was more or less like kind of a Weather Reportish type group. And I played some electric bass in Joshua Redman’s band. So on the new album which is coming out in a few days, I’m playing electric bass on some of it, just to keep the chops nice and greased up you know.
